probe_policy.declared_scope: Every current official rolling written-test row and exact retained earlier native PDF generations. This is not a complete historical examination archive.

probe_policy.native_identity_policy: Use native PDF checksum, programme and row context, year/round and regional form. Page-wide headings and file numerals do not establish event identity. Unknown replacement bytes require fresh native review.
probe_policy.successful_sync_receipt_policy: Prior receipts described wrongly assigned source material and are preserved in the baseline recovery archive. Corrected/replayed events receive no successful-sync receipt.
